name: Elizabeth M. McAvoy
bioAdditions: Her sister Agnes M. McAvoy's 1914 marriage docket again gives their father William as born in New York and dead, and their mother Catharine (Murphy) as living in Plymouth (S1). FamilySearch shows Elizabeth's siblings Mary (1879-1944), Agnes (1884-1958), William Richard Jr. (1886-1942), Katherine Frances (1888-1933), Josephine Regina (1891-1943), Gertrude Calista (1893-1971), Anna K. (1895-1964) and Claire (1899-1975) (S2). A "Lizzie McAvoy" entry in the FamilySearch index "Pennsylvania Births and Christenings" is attached to her profile (probably her Plymouth baptism), but the record page could not be opened.

conflicts.foundValue: FamilySearch shows Harold (Edward) Arnold, b. 1927, d. 1997 Altoona, son of Harold George Arnold & Martha Bowden, as husband of her DAUGHTER Elizabeth "Betsy" McGuire (b. 8 Mar 1928); a duplicate profile also attaches him to the mother.
conflicts.assessment: A man born in 1927 is almost certainly the son-in-law, not the second husband of a woman born in 1897. Her death in Altoona (1984), where Harold Arnold also died (1997), fits her living with Betsy and Harold. Recommend detaching H0383 as Elizabeth McAvoy's spouse and treating him as Betsy's husband (Betsy is on the presumed-living skip list, so no further research was done).

openQuestionsNew: FamilySearch index "Pennsylvania Births and Christenings" entry for Lizzie McAvoy (ark 1:1:HFVW-G2MM) should give her baptism date, church and sponsors.
